description: Knowledge-base manifest. Each entry points at a JSON KB file under static/kb/ that downstream code (e.g. /author constrained parametrization, Bundle H tasks) can fetch by path.

kbs.title: Casing, Tubing & Line-Pipe Operational Inventory (2019)
kbs.description: Per-pipe operator inventory: 9CAT id, type (LP/CSG/TBG), nominal size, weight, supplier, grade, connection, OD, wall, ID, drift, burst, collapse, pipe + joint yield strengths, make-up torque (min/opti/max), color bands. 299 rows covering 25 line pipe + 235 casing + 39 tubing.

kbs.title: Tubing Hanger Spools & Couplings (Miracle Industries catalogue)
kbs.description: Tubing-hanger spools (THS) sized by bottom-flange OD + top-flange OD + API 6A pressure class (2K → 15M), and tubing-hanger couplings (THC) by union-nut OD + tubing size (API EUE). Drives the tubing_hanger_spool primitive's flange / bore / prep parameters.

kbs.title: API Drill Pipe Tool-Joint Identification
kbs.description: Drill-pipe tool-joint marking scheme: combinations of grooves and slots on the tong-area band identify the grade (E75, X95, G105, S135, high-strength) and weight class (standard / heavy). Drives the drill_pipe_tool_joint primitive's marking parameters.
